product.name: pdfcn-rs
product.tagline: HAML-to-PDF, zero Chromium, one static binary
product.description: A shadcn-styled document engine that compiles an indentation-based template plus a JSON data context straight to PDF bytes in memory — no headless browser, no external process, safe to run inside a Vercel Function.
product.author: pelayo.mao@gmail.com

features.name: HAML-like templates
features.description: Indentation syntax, no closing tags, {{ interpolation }}, - for / - if / - include.

features.name: Shadcn-style components
features.description: %Card, %Badge, %InvoiceTable, %Grid and friends, pre-styled out of the box.

features.name: Tailwind-style utilities
features.description: Only the classes actually used are emitted into the stylesheet.

features.name: Embedded images
features.description: resolves against caller-supplied bytes — no network fetch at render time.

features.name: Custom fonts
features.description: Bring your own brand typeface as base64 TTF/OTF, embedded alongside the built-ins.
